title: Request data bound wholesale (javascript) — review required
description: Request data is copied onto an object without a field list: Object.assign(user, req.body). Clients can then set privileged attributes (roles, flags, ownership) the form never showed. This lexical rule flags the binding; the reviewer confirms an allowlist or picks fields explicitly.
remediation: Bind through an explicit field pick, assigning only listed fields from the request.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches wholesale binding regardless of model guards.
